# Victor Jazz — Wedding Saxophonist Cyprus

> Victor Jazz is a professional live saxophonist and flutist based in Paphos, Cyprus, specialising in wedding ceremonies, cocktail hours, and DJ + Sax evening receptions. Available island-wide across Cyprus (Paphos, Limassol, Nicosia, Ayia Napa) and for destination weddings worldwide, including Greece, Italy, France, the UAE, and beyond. Over 350 weddings performed, 5-star rated.

## Booking & Contact

- Preferred contact method: WhatsApp — fastest way to reach Victor and get a quote. Link: https://wa.me/353838980169
- Contact form: https://www.victorjazz.com/#contact
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/victorjazzsaxophone
- Response time: typically within 24 hours
- Pricing: from €350 (ceremony only) up to €900+ (full-day experience) — final quote depends on date, location, and package. See https://www.victorjazz.com/#pricing

## Services

- Wedding Ceremony — live saxophone for processional, register signing, and recessional
- Cocktail Hour & Reception — sophisticated live music for drinks receptions
- Beach & Outdoor Weddings — clifftop terraces, beach clubs, garden villas
- DJ + Sax — live saxophone layered over DJ sets for evening receptions and parties
